lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Three primary horizontal rows of high-luminance circular spots are visible posterior to the branchial region, with the median row exhibiting the highest pixel intensity and semi-regular spatial distribution.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of subtly elevated pixel intensity intersect with the primary horizontal spot rows to form a grid-like arrangement of nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance transition from a light-colored dorsal edge to a shadowed ventral region.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a high density of small-diameter spots concentrated towards the distal tip and anterior margin.
